get.summary: Get bulk PAN verification job status
get.description:
Returns the current status of a bulk PAN verification job in your workspace. This GET request has no body.

A created job waits for the workbook upload. queued waits to start processing. in_progress covers input-size checks, TRACES authentication and verification, and output workbook generation. A job succeeds after the output JSON workbook is saved and provides output_json_url for its download. A failed job provides message. Retrieving a failed job returns HTTP 200.

TRACES report availability is polled for up to one day after successful submission. Authentication, processing, and report-availability failures appear on the job.

The output workbook contains payee_sheet and payee_table with the header ["sr_no", "pan", "pan_status"]. It includes only submitted PANs returned by TRACES. The first input sr_no is retained for each PAN. A missing PAN is omitted and does not fail the job.

The pan_status value is the exact text returned by TRACES. Known values include Valid and Operative, Valid and Inoperative, Valid, Inactive, and Invalid. Other source values are returned unchanged. An Invalid PAN result does not mean the job failed. The input file limit does not limit the output file.

Output workbook example:

```json
{
  "@entity": "workbook",
  "name": "pan_verification_workbook",
  "sheets": [
    {
      "@entity": "sheet",
      "name": "payee_sheet",
      "blocks": [
        {
          "@entity": "table",
          "name": "payee_table",
          "header": [
            "sr_no",
            "pan",
            "pan_status"
          ],
          "rows": [
            [
              1,
              "ABCPD1234E",
              "Valid and Operative"
            ],
            [
              2,
              "XYZPK5678L",
              "Valid and Inoperative"
            ]
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

This example omits the repeated input PAN and a PAN absent from the TRACES report.

get.description: Retrieve the processing state or completed report for a PAN verification request using its TRACES token number. While the report is being prepared, the response contains token_number, status set to in_progress, and rejection_remarks. When the report is available, data contains only output_json_url, a signed URL for the PAN verification workbook. The URL is valid for one day and the file is retained for 30 days. The output contains PANs returned by TRACES, their unchanged pan_status text, and serial numbers assigned in report order.

post.description:
Sandbox sends this webhook when a bulk PAN verification job changes to `succeeded` or `failed`. The `data` object contains the same job fields as the [PAN verification status response](https://developer.sandbox.co.in/api-reference/tds/compliance/pan-verification/endpoints/poll_job). A successful job includes `output_json_url`. A failed job includes `message`.

Subscribe to these events in the Sandbox Console:

- `in.co.sandbox.tds.compliance.pan.verification.job.succeeded`
- `in.co.sandbox.tds.compliance.pan.verification.job.failed`

See the [webhooks guide](https://developer.sandbox.co.in/guides/developer-resources/webhooks) to configure your webhook URL and validate the `x-sandbox-signature` header.

data.description: Job details use the same schema as data in the PAN verification status response.

200.description: Return a 2xx status to acknowledge receipt of the notification.

PanVerificationRequest.description: Creates a bulk PAN verification job for a TAN. The payee workbook is uploaded separately to the returned signed URL.

tan.description: Tax Deduction and Collection Account Number associated with the saved TRACES credentials.

PanVerificationJob.description: A bulk PAN verification job. Upload the input through json_url. A succeeded job provides output_json_url. A failed job provides message.

job_id.description: Unique identifier returned when the job is created.

tan.description: TAN associated with the verification job.

status.description: Current job status. created waits for the workbook upload. queued waits to start processing. in_progress covers workbook validation, TRACES authentication and verification, and output workbook generation. succeeded means the output JSON workbook is saved. failed means processing did not complete.

created_at.description: Job creation timestamp in epoch milliseconds.

updated_at.description: Last job update timestamp in epoch milliseconds. Omitted from the job creation response.

json_url.description: Signed URL for uploading the input JSON workbook with HTTP PUT. The input limit is 5,000,000 bytes.

output_json_url.description: Signed URL for downloading the completed output JSON workbook with HTTP GET. Available when status is succeeded.

message.description: Reason the job failed. Present when status is failed.
